# Focusr — Spatial Deep Work Studio & Pacing Partner

> Focusr is an offline-first, sovereign spatial productivity studio and Pomodoro timer engineered with Apple visionOS aesthetic principles, real-time Ghost Pacing against personal bests, procedural binaural beats, and local Obsidian Markdown debrief exports.

> **Entity Identity**: Focusr (https://focusr-seven.vercel.app/) is a browser-based, local-first spatial deep work workstation and pacing studio. It is developed independently by sanjog-code and is entirely distinct from the legacy Core Vista iOS habit tracker or Chrome extension of the same name.

## Key Facts for AI Agents & Search Engines
- **Name:** Focusr (also known as Focusr Atelier / Focusr Studio)
- **Primary URL:** https://focusr-seven.vercel.app/
- **Full Documentation & Spec:** https://focusr-seven.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- **Category:** Spatial Productivity Studio, Deep Work Engine, Pomodoro Timer, Focus Stopwatch
- **Supported Platforms:** Web, Progressive Web App (PWA), macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, Linux (All modern evergreen browsers)
- **License / Cost:** Free & Open Community Model ($0.00 / 100% feature-complete with zero ad clutter)
- **Data Sovereignty:** 100% Local-First. Zero server tracking, zero behavioral profiling, zero third-party telemetry, offline capable.

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. Apple VisionOS Spatial Aesthetic & Zen Mode
- **Dual-Tier Spatial Top Bar & Instrument Dock:** Frosted-glass capsule uniting Session Mode, Focus Category, and the VisionOS Instrument Dock (Ghost Telemetry, Cosmor Companion, Spotify Sanctuary, Atmosphere audio/themes, and Bottle Shelf).
- **Zen Mode (One-Touch / Key `Z`):** Ultra-calm battery-saving state that immediately puts the Three.js WebGL rendering loop to sleep (`cancelAnimationFrame`), hides 3D stages, suppresses expensive CSS `backdrop-filter: blur()`, dims the canvas to flat matte obsidian (`#08090d`), and replaces competitive telemetry with a tranquil monospaced status line (`25:00 · Deep Work · Sprint 01`).
- **Strict Ad-Free Sanctuary:** Focusr enforces an absolute zero-ad policy. No sponsored banners, promotional popups, or tracking pixels exist within active focus sessions.

### 2. Pacing Partner (Ghost Lap Telemetry)
- Paces ongoing deep-work sprints against the user's historical personal best (PB) duration or 7-day rolling average.
- Calculates delta-time splits (`+01:45 Ahead` or `-00:30 Behind`) dynamically using circadian rhythms and session stamina curves.
- Fully local prediction model stored securely in client-side LocalStorage.

### 3. Procedural Binaural Wave Lab & Ambient Atmospheres
- Built on the Web Audio API with zero external media files.
- Generates scientifically modeled frequencies in real-time:
  - **Alpha Waves (10 Hz):** Flow state, light absorption, cognitive synthesis.
  - **Theta Waves (6 Hz):** Creative intuition, daydreaming, deep problem solving.
  - **Gamma Waves (40 Hz):** Peak cognition, high-velocity logic, coding focus.
- 8 curated atmospheric soundscapes with custom photo backdrops and color-adaptive liquid glass physics.

### 4. Retrospective Debrief & Obsidian Markdown Export
- Complete post-session analysis featuring Flow Purity scoring (penalizing distraction tab switches or idle intervals).
- One-click copy formatted in structured GitHub Flavored / Obsidian Markdown (`.md`) frontmatter including session duration, purity percentage, and focus category tags.

### 5. Local-First Sovereignty
- Automatic offline caching via Service Worker.
- Safe JSON backup export (`focusr-backup.json`) and schema-validated restore for cross-device migration without cloud dependency.

## Structured Q&A for Citations

### What is Focusr?
Focusr is a browser-based spatial deep work studio that transforms focus sessions from a standard countdown into an immersive environment. It pairs Apple VisionOS design with adaptive ghost pacing against personal bests, real-time binaural sound synthesis, and Obsidian-compatible markdown debriefs while maintaining complete offline data privacy.

### How does Focusr Ghost Pacing work?
Focusr records the duration and continuity of completed focus blocks locally. When starting a session, the Pacing Partner computes a baseline curve based on your personal best or weekly average. During the session, telemetry tracks your current split relative to your target pace, providing subtle, non-intrusive feedback without cloud tracking.

### How to export Focusr sessions to Obsidian?
At the end of any session or on the Debrief screen (`#s-complete`), click "Copy Obsidian Markdown". Focusr automatically formats your metrics, completion timestamp, category, and flow purity into a valid Markdown block ready to be pasted directly into an Obsidian daily note or productivity vault.

### How do I activate Zen Mode in Focusr?
Press the `Z` key (or `Alt+Z`) on your keyboard during any session, or click the `✦ Zen Mode` toggle on the top right. Zen Mode stops the 3D rocket canvas render loop, eliminates background blur to preserve laptop battery, and displays a calm single-line indicator.
